baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins benefits, active reaching of a need located in the breasts, and passive carriage on unspecified supports and ships.
baseline_models.mechanism: External carriers convert an inward lack or purpose into arrival: benefit supplies capacity, reaching supplies the endpoint, the breast locates the impulse, and carriage supplies the enabling motion.

activation_trace.role: Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies useful capacity and functions as the mechanism's positive affordance.
Arrival at an endpoint gives the utility a telic rather than merely consumptive function.
Need or dependence supplies the internal pressure that makes conveyance purposeful.
The bodily chest localizes the need inside the passenger rather than in the vehicle.
The ship supplies the waterborne carrier that extends the same reaching mechanism across another medium.
Visible load-bearing makes the passenger's arrival depend on support outside the passenger.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists useful things and two ordinary ways to travel.
changed_reading.after: The ayah models transport as the conversion of a chest-held need into reached reality through beneficial external support.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The addressees actively reach but are passively carried, while the repeated preposition places both terrestrial supports and ships beneath them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Agency is distributed across desire, directed action, vehicle, and medium. The passenger owns the goal grammatically, but the carrier performs the load-bearing that makes achievement possible.

activation_trace.role: Endpoint arrival is predicated actively of the passengers and supplies their directed agency.
The ship is a collective carrier whose motion cannot be reduced to the passenger's bodily effort.
Overt carrying supplies the passive support on which the active reaching is nested.
The carrying apparatus or mount makes the enabling layer a concrete system rather than an abstract favor.

changed_reading.before: Reaching a goal is simply the traveler's accomplishment.
changed_reading.after: The traveler supplies intention and direction, while arrival remains an achievement borne by a larger support system.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A need is explicitly placed in the breasts before the clause of being carried.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory lets need activate intended destination and withheld inward content, while the breast can be an origin from which acts issue. The journey can therefore begin as a private itinerary before it becomes spatial motion.

activation_trace.role: Intentional movement toward a magnified object recasts need as a destination-bearing purpose.
Holding back what is inward contributes the latent or privately carried quality of the purpose.
An origin from which actions issue turns the breast from a container into the journey's point of departure.
Arrival keeps this inward itinerary anchored to an actual endpoint rather than free association.

changed_reading.before: The chest merely stores an already obvious practical need.
changed_reading.after: The chest may be the concealed origin of an itinerary whose inward مقصد is externalized by transport.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier attempts to reach use an imagined vertical link, while pride is magnified in breasts yet explicitly not reached. The focus ayah revises reaching into a bounded, provisioned process: real carriers mediate a need, whereas self-magnifying ascent mistakes an imagined link for an effective vehicle.

activation_trace.role: Endpoint arrival anchors the focus as a successful reaching construction.
The breast as an origin of acts makes the quality of the inward impulse relevant to the route.
A first-person attempt at endpoint arrival supplies the failed or suspect comparison for the focus reaching.
A rope or connecting link renders the proposed means as a fabricated vertical connection.
The breast again serves as the source from which an attempted course proceeds.
Magnifying something in the breast identifies the inward content as self-enlarging pride.
Negated arrival demonstrates that an inwardly held target need not possess an effective route.

structural_cues: 40:36 couples first-person reaching with proposed means; 40:56 places breasts and non-reaching in one construction.
40:80 repeats both reaching and breasts but inserts supplied carriers between inward purpose and arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated BLG and SDR, an imagined link at 40:36, magnified pride and non-arrival at 40:56, and actual carriers at 40:80. I infer a contrast between provisioned mediation and self-authored ascent; a live alternative is that the repetitions contrast only particular goals, not two kinds of reaching.

changed_reading.before: Transport neutrally fulfills whatever desire happens to be in the passenger.
changed_reading.after: The ayah validates mediated, reachable purposes while the surah exposes chest-borne magnification whose imagined means do not reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus affirms present benefits, but the same benefit root is negated for excuses and for faith adopted only after overpowering force is seen. Utility becomes an affordance with a window of use, not a substance that remains effective regardless of response and timing.

activation_trace.role: Positive benefit supplies the focus ayah's usable capacity.
Negated benefit at judgment limits the assumption that every offered resource remains efficacious.
A second negated benefit closes the surah with explicit failure of late utility.
Heart-settling assent names the response that no longer benefits once delayed to this point.
Direct sight supplies the late evidentiary threshold after which the response loses benefit.
Overpowering severity identifies what has finally forced the late recognition.

structural_cues: NFA is affirmative at 40:80 but explicitly negated at 40:52 and 40:85.
At 40:85 the non-benefit follows seeing overpowering force, making sequence and timing material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the polarity reversal and the late sight-response sequence. I infer that benefit is opportunity-sensitive and use the final negation to qualify the focus utilities; the live alternative is that material benefit and judgmental benefit remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Benefits are possessions whose usefulness is stable once provided.
changed_reading.after: The provided means are present opportunities: usefulness depends on timely uptake and cannot simply be carried into a belated response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local sequence turns conveyance into an epistemic instrument. Carriage enables movement, movement enables directed looking, and looking makes surviving traces readable, so reaching is not only arrival at a private destination but access to historical evidence.

activation_trace.role: Endpoint arrival supplies the mobility that can place the observer before evidence.
The ship extends evidence-seeking mobility across water as well as land.
Load-bearing supplies the physical access on which the epistemic sequence depends.
Showing or making apparent marks the just-described utilities as displayed evidence.
A visible distinguishing sign gives the transport complex an evidentiary role.
Going and flowing converts available carriage into enacted travel.
Directing sight or insight states the cognitive operation performed after travel.
A remaining mark supplies the durable historical object that travel lets the observer inspect.

structural_cues: 40:79-80 presents riding, eating, benefits, reaching, and carriage; 40:81 immediately calls attention to displayed signs.
40:82 then commands travel in the earth, looking, and assessment of earlier peoples' outcome and traces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence from transport to signs to travel, looking, and traces. I supply the enabling arrows carriage -> travel -> inspection; the live alternative is that 40:81 labels favors generally and 40:82 begins an independent warning.

changed_reading.before: Carriers take passengers to destinations chosen for private practical needs.
changed_reading.after: Carriers can also take observers into contact with signs and historical traces, making mobility a means of accountable seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contains two passive movement systems. One bears people on useful surfaces toward their needs; the other fixes restraint to the neck, links it in chains, and drags the person. Dependence is common to both, but the relation to the carrying system reverses from afforded movement to coerced removal.

activation_trace.role: Open load-bearing supplies supported passive movement in the focus.
The ship supplies a containing surface that carries without fastening the passenger.
A collar binding an organ supplies the first constraining component of forced conveyance.
The neck localizes restraint directly on the transported body.
Connected links replace the focus ayah's beneficial carrier with a constraining transport assembly.
Dragging and extending supplies motion imposed on rather than enabled for the person.

structural_cues: 40:71 clusters body restraint, connected chains, and passive dragging.
40:80 also ends in passive human movement, but repeats 'upon' to name supportive carriers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two passive transport scenes and opposite material assemblies. I infer a deliberate reversal between supported and coerced dependence; the live alternative is that the scenes are independent and share only the broad fact of movement.

changed_reading.before: Being carried is merely a convenience that reduces walking.
changed_reading.after: Being carried is a gracious form of dependence, made legible by its inverse: bodily motion imposed through restraint and dragging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stable ground, nourishment, livestock, riding, benefits, and ships form a distributed life-support system. Some components hold people in place, some feed them, and some move them, so the focus benefits are interoperable affordances rather than isolated commodities.

activation_trace.role: Broad useful capacity lets the focus gather several life-support functions without itemizing them.
A carrying apparatus or mount supplies the mobile infrastructure layer.
Making something into a condition frames the environment as deliberately configured for use.
Fixity and settlement supply the stationary counterpart to the focus ayah's mobility.
Nourishing sustenance supplies the metabolic function within the same support ecology.
A second configured-for-you construction connects environmental provision to the immediately adjacent animals.
Livestock wealth supplies the living platform that combines several practical functions.
Riding on the back of a mount specifies the terrestrial movement function.
An edible share or provision specifies nourishment alongside mobility.

structural_cues: 40:61-64 moves through rest, visible day, stable earth, built sky, formed bodies, and provision.
40:79-80 continues with the beneficiary construction 'for you' and joins eating, riding, benefits, reaching, and carriage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated beneficiary grammar and complementary functions of settlement, food, and movement. I infer one distributed support ecology; the live alternative is a catalog of separate favors with no functional integration.

changed_reading.before: The ayah adds transport benefits to a list of unrelated goods.
changed_reading.after: The ayah completes a provision system in which habitat, nourishment, living mounts, and ships jointly sustain embodied purposes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same carrying root appears with active bearers of the Throne and with humans passively borne by vehicles. Scale and grammatical role change, but bearing remains support of another, allowing the focus carrier to be read as service rather than low status and the passenger as dependent rather than self-sufficient.

activation_trace.role: Visible carrying places humans in the passive position of supported loads.
Active bearing at a cosmic scale prevents carrying from being coded as merely menial.
Bearing an entrusted weight contributes responsibility and service to the shared carrying root.

structural_cues: 40:7 uses active plural bearers with the Throne as object; 40:80 uses passive plural humans with vehicles as supports.
The repeated HML root places exalted bearing and ordinary conveyance on one lexical axis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root, the active-passive reversal, and radically different carried objects. I infer an architecture in which bearing is entrusted support; the live alternative is that both occurrences denote physical carrying without further social resonance.

changed_reading.before: Carriers are subordinate tools and passengers are the principal actors.
changed_reading.after: Bearing is itself an honored service, while the passenger's reaching openly depends on being supported.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the non-dominant R-Y mapping of 40:81 rather than the ordinary sight branch. It remains valid as an activation because that supplied inventory contains both a need held by a person and the bringing or carrying of water, directly re-touching the focus need, carrying, and ship. Downstream prose should present it only as a split-root resonance, never as the lexical gloss of 'shows.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places a need in the breasts and people being carried on supports and ships; the immediately following ayah begins with the showing root.

activation_trace.role: Personal need supplies the first focus motif replayed by the split context inventory.
Visible carrying supplies the second focus motif replayed by the split context inventory.
The waterborne ship keeps the water-carrying resonance attached to a focus object.
A need held by a person echoes the immediately preceding chest-held need.
Bringing and carrying water echoes the immediately preceding load-bearing ship.

changed_reading.before: The following act of showing simply labels the preceding benefits as signs.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory split-root level, the showing itself replays need and water-bearing, making the transport complex feel lexically displayed as well as visually signified.

strongest_changes: The BLG-SDR recurrence turns generic goal attainment into a contrast between provisioned reaching and chest-magnified non-reaching.
Affirmative benefit at 40:80 is bounded by negated benefit at 40:52 and 40:85, making efficacy response- and time-sensitive.
The 40:79-82 sequence turns riding and carriage into access to signs, travel, looking, and historical traces.
Passive carriage becomes a gracious form of dependence when read against passive dragging in restraints.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's active reaching nested inside passive carrying became the hinge: whole-surah recurrences changed a practical transport notice into several coexisting models of mediated agency, bounded benefit, accountable mobility, and entrusted support.
remaining_uncertainties: The 40:36 and 40:56 contrast may delimit only proud ascent rather than classify chest-held purposes generally.
The negated judgmental uses of benefit may remain separate from the focus's material utilities rather than qualify them analogically.
The R-W-Y outlier is a packet-authorized split-root activation but is too form-distant to use as a direct gloss.
